title: Customer Support Specialist
description: Help customers via chat and email. Friendly team, clear career path, and real work-life balance. Salary posted upfront.
requirements: Excellent written English, patience, basic computer skills. Previous support experience preferred but not required.

title: Python Backend Developer
description: Work on APIs and data pipelines. We value clean code and honest communication. Transparent salary and remote-first culture.
requirements: Python, basic SQL, Git. 1+ years experience or strong projects. Familiarity with Flask or FastAPI a plus.

title: Marketing Coordinator
description: Coordinate campaigns, social media and events. Small team, real impact, salary range always visible.
requirements: Strong writing skills, basic Canva or similar, organized. Internship or 1 year experience preferred.

title: QA Tester (Entry Level)
description: Test web and mobile apps, write clear bug reports. We train juniors and never hide the salary.
requirements: Attention to detail, basic understanding of how websites work. No formal experience required if you have a good eye.

title: Office Administrator
description: Manage schedules, supplies and light bookkeeping. Friendly office, clear expectations, salary shown.
requirements: Organization skills, Microsoft Office basics, reliable. Previous admin experience helpful.

title: React Developer (Mid-level)
description: Build modern React applications. We post real salaries, keep job posts fresh, and reply to every applicant.
requirements: Strong React, JavaScript, CSS. 2+ years experience. TypeScript a plus.

title: Content Writer
description: Write blog posts and product copy. Flexible hours, fair pay range always listed, no ghosting.
requirements: Excellent English writing, ability to research topics. Portfolio of 3+ samples required.
